title: Architecture screen on fold 0: RegNetY-016, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B2
hypothesis: Quick fold-0 screen to choose which new architectures are worth 5 folds.

leaderboard.note: none passed the R_r18d fold-0 reference of 0.7693

findings: None of the four reached the ResNet18d reference (0.7693 on fold 0).
Higher inference resolution helps these models most (+0.06 to +0.08 on fold 0, 224 -> 320).
limitations: Fold 0 only; fold scores vary by about 0.03-0.04 across folds, so small gaps can be noise.

evidence.code: Training code is in code/ (copied from the team server export, 2026-11-12). Referenced by md5: train.py 56d4db01cdd6c2c46e7b9b3b789324fe (before the 2026-11-12 patch that added --img and corrupt_v5; default behaviour unchanged), dq.py e3e270bdcdf254ad369b1cb3c345e5e9.
